name: Bardo
source:
Returning to his native village, filled with nostalgic feelings, the main character goes on a journey. But the echo of old memories weighs heavily on his shoulders.

[Translated from [url=https://quattro-formaggi.itch.io/bardo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角回到故乡，怀着乡愁踏上旅程。但旧日记忆的回响却沉重地压在他的肩上。

[译自[url=https://quattro-formaggi.itch.io/bardo]itch.io[/url]]
